newsitem.title: USA: Provident Bancorp to reconsider applicants.
newsitem.headline: Provident Bancorp to reconsider applicants.

text.p: Provident Bancorp Inc said on Thursday that its unit, Provident Bank, has agreed to reconsider hiring some of the 1,200 people who applied for entry-level teller and clerical positions between 1988 and 1989.
The move is part of an agreement it said it reached with the Labor Department concerning a review of the company's hiring practices between 1988 and 1989 for those positions.
As part of the deal, it also would create an educational and vocational training scholarship fund for individuals who had applied for those positions in 1988 and 1989.
Provident also will set aside about $880,000 to fund the scholarship trusts and to make special payments to qualified applicants who are offered jobs.

The agreement for job offers will be in effect for five years. The company said it contemplates hiring up to 200 applicants from the period in question. The exact nature of the government review of its hiring practices was not disclosed.
